IS 13983 : 1994 Specification for stainless steel sinks for domestic purposesUDC 696.142 [669.14.018.8]CED 3Reaffirmed 20141 ScopeThis standard covers requirements regarding material,dimensions, construction and workmanship for sit-on and inset typestainless steel sinks for domestic purposes. Options are specifiedfor sinks with or without overflow holes, tap holes or selectedwaste facilities. The standard does not specify methods ofsupporting or methods of fixing and sealing sinks.2 ReferenceIS 5522 : 1992Specification for stainless steel sheets and strips forutensils (second revision)This Standard has Three Amendments.Amendment 1 and 2 is Incorporated.
